title: PRIVACY POLICY
intro: ("Finekarts," "we," "us," "our") respects the privacy of individuals and is committed to protecting personal information collected through our website, online platforms, business communications, customer and supplier relationships, commodity-trading activities, procurement activities, and related services.
This Privacy Policy explains how Finekarts collects, uses, discloses, stores, protects, and otherwise processes personal information.
By accessing or using the Finekarts website or providing personal information to Finekarts, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.
If you do not agree with this Privacy Policy, please do not use the website or provide personal information through our online services.

sections.title: 1. PURPOSE OF THIS PRIVACY POLICY
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy is intended to provide transparency regarding:
How privacy complaints and requests may be submitted; and
Circumstances in which Finekarts may be required to disclose information by law.
This Privacy Policy applies to personal information collected through Finekarts websites, forms, electronic
communications, business transactions, customer-service interactions, supplier relationships, procurement
activities, commodity-trading activities, and other applicable Finekarts business operations.
bullets: What personal information Finekarts may collect
When personal information may be disclosed
How long information may be retained
How international data transfers may occur
How cookies and similar technologies may be used

sections.title: 2. ABOUT FINEKARTS
paragraphs: Finekarts Inc. operates as a business involved in commodity trading, distribution, procurement, commercial
products, international trade, and related business activities.
Depending on the transaction, Finekarts may interact with:
Prospective customers; and
Other commercial counterparties.
Because Finekarts conducts international commercial activities, personal information may be processed in
more than one jurisdiction.

sections.title: 3. SCOPE
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy applies to personal information collected through:
Third-party services used by Finekarts; and
Other legitimate business interactions.

sections.title: 4. PERSONAL INFORMATION
paragraphs: For purposes of this Privacy Policy, "personal information" generally means information about an
identifiable individual, subject to applicable privacy legislation.
Personal information does not necessarily include information that is genuinely anonymous or aggregated
so that an individual cannot reasonably be identified.

sections.title: 5. INFORMATION WE MAY COLLECT
paragraphs: Depending on the nature of your relationship with Finekarts, we may collect information including:

subsections.title: 5.1 Contact Information
paragraphs: Website address; and
Other professional contact information.

subsections.title: 5.2 Business Information
paragraphs: We may collect:
Contract information; and
Other business-related information.

subsections.title: 5.3 Transaction Information
paragraphs: For commercial transactions, we may collect information relating to:
Banking information where commercially necessary; and
Other transaction records.

sections.title: 6. IDENTITY AND BUSINESS VERIFICATION
paragraphs: Because Finekarts participates in international commerce, we may conduct legitimate business verification
and due diligence.
This may include information concerning:
Commercial references; and
Other information reasonably required to establish the legitimacy of a business relationship.
Where legally required, Finekarts may request additional documentation to verify a counterparty.

sections.title: 7. SENSITIVE FINANCIAL OR BANKING
paragraphs: INFORMATION
Depending on the transaction, Finekarts may receive or process limited financial or banking information.
This may include information relating to:
Proof-of-funds documentation; and
Other trade-finance documentation.
Finekarts does not request passwords, PINs, security codes, or online banking credentials through ordinary
website forms.
Users should never send online banking passwords, authentication codes, or similar confidential credentials
to Finekarts.

sections.title: 8. INFORMATION FROM WEBSITE USERS
paragraphs: When you visit our website, we may automatically collect technical information such as:
Error information; and
Other technical information.
This information may be collected through server logs, cookies, analytics systems, security systems, and
similar technologies.
bullets: Search terms used on the website

sections.title: 9. INFORMATION PROVIDED VOLUNTARILY
paragraphs: You may voluntarily provide personal information when you:
Participate in a business relationship; or
Otherwise communicate with Finekarts.
You should provide only information reasonably necessary for the purpose for which it is requested.

sections.title: 10. INFORMATION FROM THIRD PARTIES
paragraphs: Finekarts may receive information from third parties, including:
Credit or commercial information providers; and
Other legitimate sources.
Where required by applicable law, Finekarts will take reasonable steps to ensure that such collection and
use is lawful.

sections.title: 11. PURPOSES FOR COLLECTING PERSONAL
paragraphs: INFORMATION
Finekarts may collect and use personal information for legitimate business purposes, including:
Marketing where legally permitted; and
Protecting the rights and property of Finekarts and others.

sections.title: 12. LEGAL BASIS FOR PROCESSING
paragraphs: Depending on the applicable jurisdiction, Finekarts may process personal information on the basis of:
Protection of rights and property; and
Other lawful bases permitted by applicable law.
Where consent is required, Finekarts will seek consent in accordance with applicable law.

sections.title: 13. CONSENT
paragraphs: Where applicable law requires consent, Finekarts will obtain consent before collecting, using, or disclosing
personal information.
Consent may be:
Electronic; or
Given through other legally recognized means.
You may withdraw consent where permitted by applicable law.
Withdrawal of consent does not necessarily affect processing already carried out lawfully before
withdrawal.

sections.title: 14. COMMERCIAL COMMUNICATIONS
paragraphs: Finekarts may communicate with customers, suppliers, prospective customers, and business partners
regarding:
Industry information; and
Other legitimate business matters.
Where required by applicable anti-spam or electronic communications legislation, Finekarts will provide
appropriate consent mechanisms and unsubscribe options.

sections.title: 15. MARKETING
paragraphs: Finekarts may use personal information for marketing where legally permitted.
Marketing may include:
Website announcements; and
Other commercial communications.
You may request to stop receiving marketing communications.

sections.title: 16. OPTING OUT OF MARKETING
paragraphs: If you no longer wish to receive marketing communications, you may:
Contact Finekarts; or
Submit a privacy request using the contact information provided below.
Opting out of marketing does not necessarily stop transactional or legally required communications.
bullets: Use the unsubscribe function included in the communication

sections.title: 17. COOKIES
paragraphs: Finekarts may use cookies and similar technologies.
Cookies may be used to:
Understand visitor behavior; and
Support marketing activities where legally permitted.

sections.title: 18. TYPES OF COOKIES
paragraphs: Depending on our website configuration, cookies may include:
Essential Cookies
Required for website functionality, security, and basic operations.
Functional Cookies
Used to remember preferences and improve user experience.
Analytics Cookies
Used to understand website traffic and performance.
Marketing Cookies
Used where applicable to support advertising and marketing activities.

sections.title: 19. COOKIE MANAGEMENT
paragraphs: You may be able to control cookies through:
Website cookie preferences; and
Other available controls.
Disabling certain cookies may affect website functionality.

sections.title: 20. THIRD-PARTY ANALYTICS
paragraphs: Finekarts may use third-party analytics services to understand website performance and visitor behavior.
Such providers may process technical information in accordance with their own privacy policies and
applicable contractual arrangements.

sections.title: 21. THIRD-PARTY SERVICE PROVIDERS
paragraphs: Finekarts may use third-party service providers for legitimate business purposes, including:
Professional services; and
Other operational functions.
Third-party providers may receive only the information reasonably necessary to provide their services,
subject to applicable contractual and legal requirements.

sections.title: 22. DISCLOSURE TO BUSINESS PARTNERS
paragraphs: Finekarts may disclose relevant information to business partners when reasonably necessary to facilitate a
transaction or provide requested services.
This may include:
Financial institutions; and
Professional advisers.
Finekarts will seek to limit disclosures to information reasonably necessary for the applicable purpose.

sections.title: 23. DISCLOSURE TO FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS
paragraphs: Where required to facilitate legitimate commercial transactions, information may be shared with:
Trade-finance institutions; and
Other authorized financial-service providers.
This may occur in connection with legitimate payment, settlement, verification, or trade-finance activities.

sections.title: 24. LETTERS OF CREDIT AND TRADE FINANCE
paragraphs: Where a transaction involves an LC, SBLC, BG, documentary collection, SWIFT communication, or similar
trade-finance instrument, relevant commercial and transaction information may be exchanged with
authorized financial institutions.
Finekarts will not knowingly request or facilitate fraudulent banking documentation.

sections.title: 25. FRAUD PREVENTION
paragraphs: Finekarts maintains a zero-tolerance position toward:
Unauthorized use of another party's information; and
Other fraudulent or unlawful conduct.
Information may be collected, retained, investigated, and disclosed where reasonably necessary to prevent
or investigate suspected fraud or unlawful activity.

sections.title: 26. AML AND SANCTIONS COMPLIANCE
paragraphs: Finekarts may conduct appropriate compliance screening relating to:
Fraud risks; and
Other applicable regulatory requirements.
Where required by law, information may be disclosed to competent authorities.

sections.title: 27. LEGAL AND REGULATORY DISCLOSURES
paragraphs: Finekarts may disclose personal information where reasonably necessary to:
Protect customers or other persons; or
Establish, exercise, or defend legal claims.

sections.title: 28. GOVERNMENT AUTHORITIES
paragraphs: Finekarts may disclose information to governmental, customs, tax, regulatory, law-enforcement, or other
competent authorities where legally required or otherwise permitted by applicable law.

sections.title: 29. INTERNATIONAL DATA TRANSFERS
paragraphs: Because Finekarts conducts international business, personal information may be transferred, accessed,
stored, or processed outside Canada.
The jurisdictions involved may include countries where:
Logistics providers operate; or
Finekarts conducts business.
Privacy protections may differ between jurisdictions.
Where required by applicable law, Finekarts will implement appropriate safeguards for international
transfers.

sections.title: 30. CROSS-BORDER PROCESSING
paragraphs: By interacting with Finekarts, you acknowledge that information necessary for legitimate business purposes
may be processed across borders, subject to applicable privacy laws and safeguards.

sections.title: 31. DATA SECURITY
paragraphs: Finekarts takes reasonable measures designed to protect personal information against:
Destruction; and
Other reasonably foreseeable security risks.
Security measures may include:
Employee procedures; and
Vendor security controls.

sections.title: 32. NO ABSOLUTE SECURITY GUARANTEE
paragraphs: No electronic transmission or storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.
Accordingly, Finekarts cannot guarantee that personal information will never be accessed, disclosed,
altered, lost, or destroyed as a result of circumstances beyond its reasonable control.

sections.title: 33. SECURITY INCIDENTS
paragraphs: If Finekarts becomes aware of a privacy or security incident involving personal information, Finekarts will
take reasonable steps to:
Comply with applicable notification requirements; and
Notify affected individuals or authorities where required by law.

sections.title: 34. DATA RETENTION
paragraphs: Finekarts retains personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes for which
it was collected, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law.
Retention periods may depend on:
Compliance requirements; and
Legitimate business needs.

sections.title: 35. BUSINESS RECORDS
paragraphs: Certain transaction and commercial information may need to be retained for extended periods because of:
Dispute resolution; or
Legal requirements.

sections.title: 36. DELETION
paragraphs: Where legally permitted, Finekarts may delete or anonymize personal information when it is no longer
reasonably required.
Certain information may need to be retained despite a deletion request where retention is legally required
or reasonably necessary.

sections.title: 37. ANONYMIZATION AND AGGREGATION
paragraphs: Finekarts may anonymize or aggregate information so that it can no longer reasonably identify an
individual.
Anonymized or aggregated information may be used for:
Operational improvement; and
Other legitimate purposes.

sections.title: 38. DATA ACCURACY
paragraphs: Finekarts seeks to maintain reasonably accurate personal information.
You may request correction of inaccurate personal information, subject to applicable law.

sections.title: 39. ACCESS REQUESTS
paragraphs: Subject to applicable law, individuals may request access to personal information held by Finekarts about
them.
A request may need to include sufficient information to verify the identity of the requester and locate the
relevant records.

sections.title: 40. CORRECTION REQUESTS
paragraphs: If you believe that personal information held by Finekarts is inaccurate or incomplete, you may request
correction.
Finekarts may require reasonable evidence supporting the requested correction.

sections.title: 41. WITHDRAWAL OF CONSENT
paragraphs: Where processing is based on consent and applicable law provides a right to withdraw consent, you may
withdraw consent by contacting Finekarts.
Withdrawal may not affect processing that occurred before withdrawal.

sections.title: 42. PRIVACY RIGHTS
paragraphs: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have rights concerning your personal information, including rights
relating to:
Marketing preferences; and
Complaints.
These rights are subject to applicable legal exceptions and limitations.

sections.title: 43. CANADIAN PRIVACY LAWS
paragraphs: Finekarts intends to comply with privacy legislation applicable to its activities.
Depending on the circumstances, applicable laws may include:
Applicable employment/privacy legislation; and
Other applicable Canadian laws.

sections.title: 44. QUEBEC USERS
paragraphs: Where Quebec privacy legislation applies to Finekarts' processing activities, Finekarts will comply with
applicable requirements, including requirements concerning consent, transparency, access, correction,
protection, retention, and privacy governance.

sections.title: 45. INTERNATIONAL USERS
paragraphs: If you access Finekarts from outside Canada, additional privacy rights may apply depending on your
jurisdiction.
Where legally applicable, Finekarts will take reasonable steps to comply with those requirements.

sections.title: 46. EUROPEAN USERS
paragraphs: Where the General Data Protection Regulation ("GDPR") or other applicable European privacy legislation
applies to Finekarts, Finekarts will process personal information in accordance with applicable
requirements.
Where applicable, individuals may have rights including:
Data portability; and
Withdrawal of consent.

sections.title: 47. CALIFORNIA USERS
paragraphs: Where California privacy laws apply to Finekarts' activities, Finekarts will provide applicable rights and
disclosures required under those laws.
Such rights may include rights to:
Opt out of certain activities where applicable; and
Exercise other rights provided by applicable California law.

sections.title: 48. CHILDREN'S PRIVACY
paragraphs: Finekarts' website and services are primarily intended for businesses and adults.
Finekarts does not knowingly seek to collect personal information from children where prohibited by
applicable law.
If you believe that a child has provided personal information to Finekarts improperly, please contact us.

sections.title: 49. BUSINESS-TO-BUSINESS PLATFORM
paragraphs: Finekarts operates primarily in a business-to-business environment.
Information supplied by business representatives may therefore be used for legitimate commercial
purposes, including:
Commercial negotiations; and
Transaction management.

sections.title: 50. BUSINESS CONTACT INFORMATION
paragraphs: Business contact information may be treated differently under certain privacy laws than personal consumer
information.
Nevertheless, Finekarts seeks to handle business contact information responsibly and only for legitimate
purposes.

sections.title: 51. CONFIDENTIAL BUSINESS INFORMATION
paragraphs: Personal information may form part of confidential business information.
Finekarts may protect such information through:
Internal policies; and
Other reasonable safeguards.

sections.title: 52. CONFIDENTIALITY OF TRANSACTIONS
paragraphs: Finekarts may maintain confidentiality regarding legitimate commercial transactions, subject to:
Compliance obligations; and
Other lawful disclosure requirements.

sections.title: 53. AGENTS AND BROKERS
paragraphs: Where agents or brokers participate in a transaction, Finekarts may process their business and contact
information for:
Transaction management; and
Other legitimate business purposes.

sections.title: 54. LOGISTICS AND SHIPPING
paragraphs: Personal information may be disclosed to logistics providers where necessary for:
Cargo handling; and
Related activities.

sections.title: 55. INSPECTION COMPANIES
paragraphs: Where independent inspection is required, relevant information may be shared with inspection providers
for legitimate inspection, verification, certification, and reporting purposes.

sections.title: 56. CUSTOMS AND TRADE COMPLIANCE
paragraphs: Information may be processed or disclosed to facilitate:
Product classification; and
Other international trade requirements.

sections.title: 57. THIRD-PARTY WEBSITES
paragraphs: The Finekarts website may contain links to third-party websites.
Finekarts is not responsible for:
Third-party cookies; or
Third-party data processing.
Users should review the privacy policies of third-party websites before providing information.

sections.title: 58. SOCIAL MEDIA
paragraphs: Finekarts may maintain or use social-media platforms.
Interactions with those platforms may be subject to the privacy policies and terms of those third-party
providers.
Finekarts does not control the privacy practices of third-party social-media platforms.

sections.title: 59. EMAIL COMMUNICATIONS
paragraphs: Electronic communications may be monitored, filtered, archived, or retained for:
Fraud prevention; and
Legal purposes.

sections.title: 60. WEBSITE SECURITY MONITORING
paragraphs: Finekarts may use security technologies to detect:
Suspicious transactions; and
Other security threats.
Technical information collected for security purposes may be retained as reasonably necessary.

sections.title: 61. IP ADDRESSES
paragraphs: IP addresses may be processed for:
Troubleshooting; and
Compliance.
An IP address may constitute personal information in certain jurisdictions.

sections.title: 62. DO-NOT-TRACK SIGNALS
paragraphs: Where applicable law requires Finekarts to recognize browser-based privacy signals, Finekarts will
implement such requirements in accordance with applicable law and technical capabilities.

sections.title: 63. AUTOMATED DECISION-MAKING
paragraphs: Finekarts does not intend to make decisions producing significant legal or similarly significant effects solely
through automated processing unless legally permitted and appropriate safeguards are implemented.

sections.title: 64. CREDIT AND COMMERCIAL DUE DILIGENCE
paragraphs: For certain transactions, Finekarts may perform commercial due diligence, including reviewing:
Ownership information; and
Other information reasonably required to assess transaction risk.

sections.title: 65. FRAUDULENT INFORMATION
paragraphs: If information supplied to Finekarts is suspected to be fraudulent, misleading, forged, stolen, or unlawfully
obtained, Finekarts may:
Notify appropriate parties; and
Report information to authorities where required or permitted by law.

sections.title: 66. IDENTITY THEFT AND IMPERSONATION
paragraphs: Finekarts may investigate suspected impersonation or unauthorized use of:
Banking information; or
Other identifying information.

sections.title: 67. DATA MINIMIZATION
paragraphs: Finekarts seeks to collect personal information reasonably necessary for legitimate purposes and does not
intentionally seek unnecessary personal information.

sections.title: 68. EMPLOYEE AND CONTRACTOR ACCESS
paragraphs: Access to personal information within Finekarts may be limited to employees, contractors, representatives,
or service providers who reasonably require access for legitimate purposes.

sections.title: 69. CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS
paragraphs: Individuals and service providers who receive personal information may be subject to contractual,
professional, legal, or organizational confidentiality obligations.

sections.title: 70. CORPORATE TRANSACTIONS
paragraphs: If Finekarts participates in a merger, acquisition, restructuring, financing, sale of assets, reorganization, or
similar transaction, personal information may be transferred as part of the transaction where legally
permitted.
Any such transfer will remain subject to applicable privacy requirements.

sections.title: 71. LEGAL CLAIMS
paragraphs: Finekarts may retain and process personal information reasonably necessary to:
Collect amounts owed; or
Comply with legal proceedings.

sections.title: 72. RECORDS MANAGEMENT
paragraphs: Finekarts may maintain records necessary to demonstrate:
Supplier relationships; and
Other legitimate business activities.

sections.title: 73. PRIVACY COMPLAINTS
paragraphs: If you believe Finekarts has improperly handled your personal information, you may submit a complaint to
Finekarts.
Complaints should include sufficient information to allow Finekarts to investigate the issue.
Finekarts will review and respond to privacy complaints within a reasonable period, subject to applicable
law.

sections.title: 74. REGULATORY COMPLAINTS
paragraphs: Where applicable law provides a right to complain to a privacy regulator or supervisory authority,
individuals may exercise that right.

sections.title: 75. VERIFICATION OF PRIVACY REQUESTS
paragraphs: For security reasons, Finekarts may need to verify the identity of an individual submitting a privacy request.
Finekarts will seek to avoid collecting unnecessary identification information for this purpose.

sections.title: 76. AUTHORIZED REPRESENTATIVES
paragraphs: Where permitted by applicable law, an authorized representative may submit a privacy request on behalf of
another individual.
Finekarts may require evidence of authorization.

sections.title: 77. RESPONSE TIMES
paragraphs: Finekarts will respond to privacy requests within the timeframe required by applicable law.
Where permitted, additional time may be taken when reasonably necessary because of the complexity or
volume of the request.

sections.title: 78. EXCEPTIONS TO PRIVACY RIGHTS
paragraphs: Privacy rights may be subject to exceptions or limitations under applicable law.
Finekarts may therefore decline or partially fulfill a request where legally permitted or required.

sections.title: 79. COSTS
paragraphs: Finekarts generally does not charge individuals for ordinary privacy requests where prohibited by law.
Where applicable law permits reasonable administrative fees, Finekarts may charge such fees after
providing appropriate notice.

sections.title: 80. CHANGES TO THIS PRIVACY POLICY
paragraphs: Finekarts may update this Privacy Policy from time to time.
Changes may be made to reflect:
New services; or
Changes to privacy practices.
The updated version will be posted on the website with a revised "Last Updated" date.

sections.title: 81. MATERIAL CHANGES
paragraphs: Where required by applicable law, Finekarts will provide appropriate notice of material changes to this
Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 82. CONTINUED USE
paragraphs: Where permitted by applicable law, continued use of the Finekarts website following publication of an
updated Privacy Policy constitutes acknowledgment of the updated policy.

sections.title: 83. PRIVACY POLICY AND WEBSITE TERMS
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy should be read together with the Finekarts Website Terms and Conditions.
Where a conflict exists, applicable privacy legislation will prevail to the extent required by law.

sections.title: 84. CONTRACTUAL DOCUMENTS
paragraphs: Privacy matters relating to a particular commercial transaction may also be governed by contractual
provisions contained in:
Confidentiality Agreements; and
Other transaction-specific agreements.
Nothing in this Privacy Policy overrides mandatory privacy legislation.

sections.title: 85. DATA PROCESSORS AND SERVICE PROVIDERS
paragraphs: Where Finekarts engages third-party service providers to process personal information on its behalf,
Finekarts may implement reasonable contractual or other safeguards appropriate to the nature of the
processing and applicable legal requirements.

sections.title: 86. CLOUD SERVICES
paragraphs: Finekarts may use cloud-based services for:
Data backup; and
Other legitimate business operations.
Cloud providers may process information in jurisdictions outside Canada.

sections.title: 87. PAYMENT SECURITY
paragraphs: Finekarts seeks to use reasonable safeguards when handling payment-related information.
Users should verify payment instructions independently and should not rely solely on an email requesting
changes to banking details.

sections.title: 88. PAYMENT-FRAUD WARNING
paragraphs: Finekarts will not knowingly request passwords, online-banking credentials, authentication codes, or similar
confidential banking credentials through ordinary business communications.
If you receive suspicious instructions allegedly from Finekarts requesting a change to banking details, you
should independently verify the request using a trusted communication channel.

sections.title: 89. BANKING INFORMATION CHANGES
paragraphs: Because international trade may involve significant financial transactions, Finekarts may implement
verification procedures before accepting changes to payment or banking information.

sections.title: 90. NO SALE OF PERSONAL INFORMATION
paragraphs: Finekarts does not intend to sell personal information as a commercial commodity.
Where applicable law defines certain disclosures or transfers as a "sale" or "sharing" of personal
information, Finekarts will comply with the applicable legal requirements.

sections.title: 91. NO UNAUTHORIZED COMMERCIAL USE
paragraphs: Personal information obtained through Finekarts should not be:
Used to commit fraud; or
Used for unlawful solicitation.

sections.title: 92. WEBSITE SCRAPING
paragraphs: Unauthorized scraping, harvesting, extraction, copying, or automated collection of personal information
from the Finekarts website is prohibited to the extent permitted by applicable law.

sections.title: 93. PROTECTION OF BUSINESS PARTNERS
paragraphs: Finekarts may take reasonable steps to protect the personal and business information of legitimate:
Customers; and
Other business partners.

sections.title: 94. LAW ENFORCEMENT
paragraphs: Finekarts may cooperate with law-enforcement agencies and competent authorities where legally required
or where reasonably necessary to prevent or investigate unlawful activity.

sections.title: 95. NATIONAL SECURITY AND PUBLIC SAFETY
paragraphs: Finekarts may disclose information where legally required for matters involving:
Sanctions enforcement; or
Other legally recognized grounds.

sections.title: 96. BUSINESS CONTINUITY
paragraphs: Finekarts may maintain backups and redundant systems to protect information against:
Human error; and
Other operational risks.

sections.title: 97. DATA BREACH RESPONSE
paragraphs: Where a security breach creates risks requiring notification under applicable law, Finekarts will follow
applicable notification and reporting requirements.

sections.title: 98. PRIVACY GOVERNANCE
paragraphs: Finekarts may maintain internal privacy and information-security procedures appropriate to the nature and
scale of its business activities.
These procedures may address:
Vendor management; and
Privacy requests.

sections.title: 99. ACCOUNTABILITY
paragraphs: Finekarts seeks to maintain reasonable accountability for personal information under its control and may
designate an individual or function responsible for privacy matters.

sections.title: 100. CONTACT INFORMATION
paragraphs: Privacy-related questions, requests, complaints, or concerns may be directed to:
Finekarts Inc.
Privacy Officer: [INSERT NAME / TITLE]
Address: [INSERT BUSINESS ADDRESS]
Email: [INSERT PRIVACY EMAIL]
Telephone: [INSERT TELEPHONE NUMBER]
For privacy requests, please clearly identify the nature of your request and provide sufficient information to
allow Finekarts to respond.

sections.title: 101. PRIVACY REQUEST PROCEDURE
paragraphs: A written privacy request should generally include:
The relevant timeframe, if known; and
Any other information reasonably necessary to process the request.
Please do not send passwords, banking credentials, security codes, or other unnecessary sensitive
information.
bullets: Your business or organization, if applicable
The personal information involved, if known

sections.title: 102. PRIVACY OFFICER
paragraphs: Finekarts may designate a Privacy Officer or responsible privacy contact to oversee privacy matters.
The Privacy Officer may be responsible for:
Regulatory communications; and
Privacy compliance.

sections.title: 103. APPLICABLE LAW
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy is intended to operate in accordance with applicable Canadian privacy legislation and
other applicable laws.
Nothing in this Privacy Policy limits any mandatory rights provided to individuals under applicable law.

sections.title: 104. GOVERNING LAW
paragraphs: Subject to mandatory privacy legislation applicable to an individual, this Privacy Policy shall generally be
interpreted in accordance with the laws of Ontario and the applicable laws of Canada.
Mandatory privacy laws of another jurisdiction may apply where legally required.

sections.title: 105. SEVERABILITY
paragraphs: If any provision of this Privacy Policy is determined to be invalid, unlawful, or unenforceable, that provision
will be interpreted or limited to the extent necessary, and the remaining provisions will continue to apply to
the extent permitted by law.

sections.title: 106. NO WAIVER
paragraphs: Finekarts' failure to enforce any provision of this Privacy Policy does not constitute a waiver of its rights.

sections.title: 107. ENTIRE PRIVACY POLICY
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy represents Finekarts' general privacy practices relating to the website and covered
business activities as described herein.
Additional privacy notices may apply to specific products, services, transactions, employment relationships,
or jurisdictions.

sections.title: 108. LANGUAGE
paragraphs: If this Privacy Policy is translated into another language, the translation is intended to facilitate
understanding.
Where permitted by law, the English version shall govern in the event of an inconsistency.

sections.title: 109. ACKNOWLEDGEMENT
paragraphs: By using the Finekarts website or voluntarily providing personal information to Finekarts, you acknowledge
that:
You understand that information may be disclosed where legally required or reasonably necessary
for legitimate business purposes; and
You understand that mandatory privacy rights under applicable law are not excluded by this Privacy
Policy.
bullets: You have had an opportunity to review this Privacy Policy
You understand that Finekarts may collect and process personal information as described herein
You understand that international business activities may involve cross-border processing

sections.title: 110. COMMITMENT TO PRIVACY
paragraphs: Finekarts is committed to conducting legitimate international commerce while respecting the privacy,
confidentiality, security, and legal rights of individuals and business partners.
Finekarts is committed to working with legitimate:
Suppliers; and
Business partners.
Finekarts does not welcome fraudulent transactions, identity theft, forged documents, unauthorized use of
personal information, money laundering, sanctions evasion, or other unlawful activities.
Finekarts will take reasonable and lawful measures to protect personal information and maintain the
integrity of its commercial platform.

sections.title: 111. EFFECTIVE DATE
paragraphs: Effective Date:
